label: Benvenuto's (Italian-American, dinner)
note: Two dense single-column pages with pipe-separated prices. Traps: CHICKEN PARMIGIANA appears twice with different descriptions (a pasta on p1, a sandwich on p2) — both are real dishes and must survive dedupe; FOUR MEAT (calzone) vs FOUR MEAT COMBO (pizza); add-on lines, toppings and dressings lists that are not dishes. Transcribed from the PDF's own text layer, checked against the rendered pages.
